description: Copy this file to dataset.json. Set up for Cabauw BSRN 1 Hz irradiance + FINO1 10 Hz sonic wind at 80 m, converted with tools/convert_to_csv.py (which writes time,value columns). File paths are relative to this folder. Each file is a CSV with a header row; time is ISO-8601 ('2010-07-01 06:30:01') or numeric seconds.
ambient_temp_note: Assumption: IEC standard test temperature. The Cabauw irradiance file has no temperature column; supply a measured series under 'temperature' to replace it.
